description: Exchange rates / currency conversion table: Coinbase's full rate table for one base currency against every crypto and fiat currency it quotes (USD to BTC, ETH, EUR, GBP, JPY...). Use it to convert amounts between currencies. Input: currency code such as USD. $0.02 per call. Returns: currency, rates{}.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_market_rates
title: Currency exchange rates
